SELECT ?band ?member ?show WHERE {
  ?band wdt:P527 ?member.
  ?member wdt:P106 wd:Q639669;  # occupation: musician
          wdt:P361 ?band.
  ?show wdt:P175 ?member;
        wdt:P31 wd:Q15416;       # instance of: television show
        rdfs:label ?showLabel.
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?showLabel), "mtv"))
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?showLabel), "you can't see me"))
  ?member wdt:P737 ?defari.      # Defari linked somehow (this may need to be adjusted)
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?defari)), "defari"))
}
